target_reference_entry: C. Wang, L. Xie, Y. Lin, W. Wang, Y. Chen, Y. Bu, K. Zhang, and S. Lu, “Thru-the-wall eavesdropping on loudspeakers via RFID by capturing sub-mm level vibration,” Proc. ACM IMWUT, vol. 5, no. 4, pp. 1–25, 2021.
paper_level_summary_zh: 该论文在相关工作部分将目标论文列为具有长波长的无线振动测量方法，指出其位移灵敏度有限，属于普通的相关工作介绍。

evidences.evidence_context: Wireless systems based on long-wavelength signals represented by RFID [5], [6] have limited displacement sensitivity.
evidences.reference_entry: C. Wang, L. Xie, Y. Lin, W. Wang, Y. Chen, Y. Bu, K. Zhang, and S. Lu, “Thru-the-wall eavesdropping on loudspeakers via RFID by capturing sub-mm level vibration,” Proc. ACM IMWUT, vol. 5, no. 4, pp. 1–25, 2021.
evidences.why_this_judgment_zh: 正文将目标论文作为RFID代表性方法，指出其位移灵敏度有限，属于负面/限制性陈述，且未提及目标论文的亚毫米级感知能力，更不涉及首次声称。
evidences.copy_ready_zh: 该论文在相关工作部分将目标论文归类为长波长RFID方法，并指出其位移灵敏度有限。
